title: Reproduce: Gallstone Disease and Its Association With Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease, All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality.
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 35643414 (Gallstone Disease and Its Association With Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease, All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality.) using NHANES or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 35643414: Gallstone Disease and Its Association With Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease, All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality. Primary endpoint: NAFLD and mortality patterns among individuals with gallstone disease. Use NHANES or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: NAFLD and mortality patterns among individuals with gallstone disease
rediscovery_target: Recover the association between gallstone disease, NAFLD, and mortality outcomes.
new_discovery_target: Test whether metabolic-risk strata sharpen gastroenterology risk stratification in the same survey setting.
